title: HushSpec Evidence Report v0.1
description: An aggregation over decision receipts and policy-in-effect events for one window (RFC 09 P3-01, `h2h report --format json`). A report is derived evidence: every number is counted from recorded receipts (spec/hushspec-receipt.md) and never re-evaluated, so a report cannot disagree with the receipts it summarizes. When the inputs were hash-linked logs (spec/hushspec-log.md), `chain_verified` says whether the chain verified; a report over a broken chain is only produced when the operator asked for one, and is stamped false.

report_version.description: Report document format version. Consumers MUST reject an unknown value.

generated_at.description: When the report was produced. Absent when the producer was asked for a byte-stable document (a test vector).

sources.description: The inputs, as the caller named them, in the order they were read.

chain_verified.description: Whether every input log's hash chain verified. Absent when the inputs were plain receipt JSONL, which has no chain to verify.

rule_blocks.description: One row per rule block or engine stage named by any receipt's trace, ordered by block id.

action_types.description: One row per evaluated action type, ordered by type.

policies.description: One row per policy content hash the receipts named, ordered by hash.

policy_timeline.description: The policy_loaded and policy_swapped records in the window, in log order: what was in force, and when it changed.

actors.description: One row per distinct (agent_id, session_id, principal) triple, ordered by that triple.

detections.description: One row per detector that ran, ordered by detector id.

ContentHash.description: A content hash in the wire form defined by spec/hushspec-canonical.md section 5.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with exactly millisecond precision, as receipts spell it.

DecisionTotals.description: Receipts by evaluated policy decision (core spec section 6), independent of what the enforcement point did.

ModeTotals.description: Receipts by the effective enforcement mode (receipt spec section 4.7).

OutcomeTotals.description: Receipts by what the enforcement point did (receipt spec section 4.7).

LevelTotals.description: Detector evaluations by the level their score mapped to under the policy's thresholds.

Window.description: The window the report covers: the bounds asked for, and the bounds observed. Both bounds are inclusive; a record whose timestamp is not RFC 3339 is outside any bounded window.

first_receipt.description: Timestamp of the earliest receipt counted.

last_receipt.description: Timestamp of the latest receipt counted.

ChainSummary.description: What the log verifier said about the inputs, summed across files. Each input file is verified on its own; the link between rotated files is `h2h log verify`'s job.

reason.description: Why verification failed, as file:line: message. Present only when verified is false.

skipped_lines.description: Input lines that did not parse and were skipped under --lenient. Zero in a fail-closed run, which refuses to report at all when a line does not parse.

RuleBlockRow.description: One rule block or engine stage across the window. `fired` is the subset of `evaluated` whose outcome was not allow, which is exactly warn + deny because an evaluated entry has no other outcome.

rule_block.description: The same closed set the receipt schema uses for rule_trace[].rule_block.

receipts.description: Receipts whose trace named this block.

evaluated.description: Trace entries whose matching logic ran.

skipped.description: Trace entries recorded as applicable but inert (absent, disabled, or a false `when`).

top_rule_paths.description: The most frequently recorded rule paths for this block, most frequent first, ties broken by path.

PolicyRow.description: One policy, identified the way a receipt identifies it: by the content hash of the resolved document.

ActorRow.description: One actor across the window. A row with no identity fields counts the receipts that named no actor at all.

SignatureSummary.description: Policy-signature status as each receipt recorded it at load time (signing spec section 6). `absent` counts receipts whose runtime did not attempt verification at all.

reasons.description: Why verification failed, by reason code, ordered by reason.

matched.description: Evaluations that met a policy threshold and contributed to a decision.

ControlEvidenceRow.description: One control's evidence: what the policy says implements it, and what the receipts recorded against those paths.

rule_blocks.description: The rule blocks those paths were observed under in the receipts.

receipts.description: Receipts in which at least one mapped path was consulted.

registered.description: Whether the framework id is in spec/registries/frameworks.yaml. Registration is advisory (core spec section 2.5.1).

controls.description: In the order the policy declared the mappings.

ControlsEvidence.description: The metadata.controls join, present when a policy was supplied or one could be resolved from the log's policy events.

policy_source.description: The policy the mappings were read from, as the caller named it.

receipts_matching_policy.description: Receipts in the window that name policy_content_hash. Evidence for a control is only as strong as this number: a receipt evaluated under a different policy proves nothing about these mappings.

unmapped_fired_rule_blocks.description: Rule blocks that fired in the window with no control mapping behind them: the coverage gap lint L011 flags statically, observed dynamically.
